brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Kilnroom, the online shop in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: handmade and warm but not rustic or folksy; no pottery wheels, no vase or mug silhouettes, no flames. It must work on a shipping label, a tissue-paper sticker and Instagram. Web and social only; customers in Turkey and Europe.

claim.notes: Üç yönden hiçbiri kalite kapısını geçemedi (maker-stamp ve k-gate iki eskiz incelemesinde de 'none' aldı; doorway iki geliştirme turunda ortalama 6,31 ve distinctiveness 4-5 ile kaldı), bu yüzden bitirme, dışa aktarma ve galeri adımları çalıştırılmadı.

concepts.title: Doorway
readsAs: cabinet or shelf with a lit door
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 keyhole/doorbell on an arch block; s2 six tombstones or windows; s3 an open door in an arch; s4 a P or cane; s5 a sliced arch (struck, cut device). Keep s3: heavy open arch, one slab swung open, survives 16px. Fix: make it work one-colour (slab as knocked-out or hatched shape), push the slab angle/perspective so it is not an exit-door icon, vary arch stroke to avoid generic UI geometry.

concepts.title: K Gate
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 K in app-icon slab; s2 K in disc badge; s4 split-K, stem detached from wedge arms (also back/rewind feel). Struck: initial with a cut or in a container. s4 is best crafted but is still a K with the stem split off. Try: drop the K, or one continuous K stroke with no detached stem.

concepts.title: Maker's Stamp
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 bubbles/pebbles cluster; s2 ring with notification dot; s3 eclipse/lens or O; s4 caterpillar/loading dots. None carries a stamp or provenance idea; all generic blobs. Try: a single silhouette whose edge is the impression (a pressed, slightly bruised rim or a hand-cut notch) rather than circles arranged.
